description: Opt-out for Radaris (radaris.com). Fills the name search automatically, then hands the listing pick and confirmation to a person.
steps.7.text: Radaris needs you to finish this one. Go to radaris.com/control-privacy, search for {full_name} and your city, click your own profile, then press the blue "Start Removing" button. Enter {contact_email} as the email address and submit. Radaris emails a link to that address; OpenOptOut clicks it for you.
